sampling: Purposive demo sample, NOT a random sample of the cohort: Group A athletes are over-sampled so the primary analysis can be executed end to end. Do not use for inference about the CAA population.

recoded_columns.province: arbitrary group code, seeded permutation, mapping not released

deidentification.ages: rounded to whole years, so a date of birth cannot be reconstructed

condition_of_use: No attempt may be made to re-identify any individual in this extract, or to link it to any other dataset for that purpose.
